name: Southern Uniforms — Shopify store
summary: Moving the Southern Uniforms online store from Botble (Laravel) to Shopify on the Grow plan, with a custom theme built from the approved Figma design.
description: Southern Uniforms sells uniforms and workwear to individuals and organisations across health and aged care, corporate, hospitality, education, trade and other industries. This project replaces the current Botble (Laravel) store with a Shopify store: a custom theme built on Shopify's Horizon theme, the product catalogue, checkout and payments, shipping, policies, tracking, SEO and redirects, testing and go-live.
businessObjective: Launch a Shopify store that customers can browse and buy from, on a platform the business can run with minimal custom development, while protecting search rankings from the current site. The store supports three ways to buy: retail (1–9 pieces online), wholesale (10+ pieces, quoted with volume pricing and logo branding) and supply contracts (a fixed range and price for 1–3 years).
background: A platform comparison of Botble, Shopify and a headless build was completed on 20 Oct 2026, and a recommendation for the Shopify Grow plan ($114 per month billed yearly, AUD) was sent to Ashwin on 21 Oct 2026. The work is planned in three phases: Phase 1 (launch foundations) is in progress; Phase 2 (growth and automation) and Phase 3 (scale and loyalty) are a starting list only and are not yet agreed. Project tracking, decisions, admin guides and weekly updates are kept in the Southern Uniforms Go-live hub in Notion.
responsibilitySummary: Developer and project owner for the Shopify migration
responsibilities: Shopify store setup and configuration (payments, shipping, customer accounts, notifications)
Custom theme development on Shopify Horizon, built from the Figma design
Admin guide and a retail manager handout covering the whole process
Phase 1 tracking, decision log and weekly status updates for the business contact
progressSummary: The theme is built on the preview (dev) branch and the catalogue is imported. Checkout, 10% GST, notification emails and logos are done; payments are in test mode and flat rate shipping is added. Waiting on products from Sally; once received, the end-to-end flow will be tested again and SEO will start, following the Scrubness approach.
sourceNote: Status from the Notion Phase 1 tracker (last updated 27 Oct 2026), the theme's change history to 8 Nov 2026, the storefront as checked on 16 Nov 2026, and updates from Mahesh on 16 Nov 2026.
